items.title: Take Two Interactive (TTWO) Stock Jumps As Q2 Results Keep GTA VI Central
items.summary: Traders loved what they saw from Take-Two Interactive Software today. The stock jumped 8.3% to US$224.64 after the company posted Q2 FY2027 results that kept the Grand Theft Auto VI story firmly in control of the narrative. The emotional driver was clear. Net bookings of US$1.6b landed just under guidance, yet the market cheered management’s decision to reaffirm full year net bookings of US$8.0b to US$8.2b and to stick with a plan to finish the year in a net cash position. Price action...

items.title: Take-Two Interactive earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) is trading at $222.37, up 7.22% (as of Nov 10, 12:30 PM EST). That comes despite a headline miss. Fiscal Q2 2027 (reported Nov 9) showed EPS of -$0.29 against a $0.97 estimate. Revenue was $1.50B against $1.58B expected. The stock is still down 13.63% YTD, so this looks like a relief rally rather than a breakout.
